map.给定采样率 f_s 与 FFT 点数 N，输出相邻频率 bin 间距 Δf 与可: Given sampling rate fs and FFT length N, output the adjacent frequency-bin spacing Deltaf and the upper analyzable frequency limit.
map.N 点 FFT 的频率分辨率为采样率除以点数。: The frequency resolution of an N-point FFT is the sampling rate divided by the number of points.
map.Δf = f_s / N；N 越大分辨率越高。: Deltaf = fs / N; the larger N, the higher the resolution.
map.采样率 fs 与点数 N 决定频率分辨率 df = fs/N。: Sampling rate fs and length N determine the frequency resolution df = fs/N.
map.区分相近频率分量所需的点数测算。: Estimate the number of points needed to separate closely spaced frequency components.
map.加窗前评估频谱泄漏与分辨率。: Evaluate spectral leakage and resolution before windowing.
map.分辨率 df = 1000 / 1024 ≈ 0.977 Hz，即相邻谱线间隔约: Resolution df = 1000 / 1024 ~ 0.977 Hz, i.e. the spacing between adjacent spectral lines is about 1Hz.
map.若 N 增到 8192，则 df ≈ 0.122 Hz，能分辨更接近的频率。: If N increases to 8192, then df ~ 0.122 Hz, able to resolve closer frequencies.
map.增大 N（更长的采集时间）或降低 fs，df = fs/N。: Increase N (longer acquisition time) or lower fs, df = fs/N.
map.分辨率与泄漏是一回事吗？: Are resolution and leakage the same thing?
map.不是，分辨率是谱线间隔，泄漏由截断窗引起，二者需分别处理。: No, resolution is the line spacing while leakage is caused by the truncation window; they must be handled separately.
